A '''night-flower''' was a type of [[Carnivorous plant/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Flower/Legends|flower]] from [[Forlonis Minor]],<ref name="HONSBS" /> a celestial body located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Forlonis Minor system/Legends|Forlonis Minor system]]</ref> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="The Gungan General">Since this story depicts [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]] as still alive, these events take place before {{TCW|The Gungan General}}.</ref> an apprentice [[Foodstuff/Legends|pastry]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] on the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]'' wore an elaborate [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] that reminded the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] of a night-flower from Forlonis Minor.<ref name="HONSBS" />
